Class RamanSpectrum

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.Spectrum
global.thalion.ttio.RamanSpectrum
public class RamanSpectrum extends Spectrum
1-D Raman spectrum: wavenumber + intensity arrays plus laser excitation / power / integration metadata.

API status: Stable (v0.11, M73).

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIORamanSpectrum, Python ttio.raman_spectrum.RamanSpectrum.

  • Constructor Details

    • RamanSpectrum

      public RamanSpectrum(double[] wavenumberValues, double[] intensityValues, int indexPosition, double scanTimeSeconds, double excitationWavelengthNm, double laserPowerMw, double integrationTimeSec)
      Construct a Raman spectrum from parallel wavenumber and intensity arrays.
      Parameters:
      wavenumberValues - per-point Raman shifts in cm^-1
      intensityValues - per-point intensities parallel to wavenumberValues
      indexPosition - zero-based position in the parent AcquisitionRun
      scanTimeSeconds - scan time in seconds from run start
      excitationWavelengthNm - laser excitation wavelength in nm
      laserPowerMw - laser power at the sample in mW
      integrationTimeSec - per-spectrum integration time in seconds
